notes: Declared in the run output (02c CORPUS SELECTION RULE), not in a pre-run lock. The declaration writes filter=referenced_works:W3123222584 and per_page; the executed request used filter=cites:W3123222584 and per-page. OpenAlex documents cites:W as the works that have W in their referenced_works, so the two may select the same works, and it accepts both per-page spellings. That equivalence is not tested here: the textual mismatch is recorded, not resolved.
